feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass fed Grain-finished Locally Raised Maine Beef

notes: Checked the homepage, livestock practices page, know your farmer page and farm store page. Fifth-generation family farm in Canton on about 200 acres; the homepage calls the beef grass fed and grain-finished, and the practices page describes rotational grazing plus local grain. Deposits for quarter, side and whole beef and bundles are ordered online with pickup scheduled at the farm. The homepage says shipping to your home is available (through a ChopLocal shop) but names no states, so no shipping channel was recorded; the Verifier should check the ChopLocal page. No feeding details for pigs or hens. The practices page shows a ribeye image credited to Hazy Ridge Pasture LLC; unclear if resold. Also a Poulin Grain dealer. No phone listed. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary.
